commands.name: status
commands.description: Check the local authenticated bridge and renderer readiness.

commands.name: app.state
commands.description: Return active project, conversation, Agent status, active run ID, pause state, selection, viewport, node summaries, and recent messages.

commands.name: canvas.state
commands.description: Return the active project and local canvas revision, selection, canonical relations, Requirement input bindings and revision/signature, canonical container membership, presentation layout membership, and per-node lock/busy details. Managed asset paths and automation credentials are never returned.

commands.name: project.list
commands.description: List projects and the active project ID.

commands.name: project.switch
commands.description: Switch to an existing project.

commands.name: project.create
commands.description: Create and activate a project.

commands.name: project.rename
commands.description: Rename the active project.

commands.name: canvas.select
commands.description: Atomically replace the canvas selection. Every supplied node ID and primaryId must exist; a mixed valid/stale list fails without changing selection. Use an empty ids array to clear selection.

commands.name: canvas.connect
commands.description: Atomically add one or more exact graph edges. Requirement targets accept multiple image inputs and persist inputRole as SOURCE or REFERENCE; ordinary targets keep one parent. Connections never execute a Requirement. Replacing an existing ordinary parent requires replaceExisting=true.

commands.name: canvas.disconnect
commands.description: Atomically remove the exact listed graph edges. Requirement bindings and their primary compatibility parent are recomputed together. If any requested edge is stale or absent, no edge is removed.

commands.name: canvas.group
commands.description: Atomically group an explicit set of compatible image results or containers into one canonical image container. Unsupported, empty, layer, stale, or locked members fail the whole command; no partial subset is grouped.

commands.name: canvas.dissolve
commands.description: Atomically dissolve one or more exact visible image-container hosts, restore their members as independent canvas results, and preserve provenance relations. Any stale or locked container fails the whole command.

commands.name: canvas.nudge
commands.description: Atomically move explicit nodes or visible container hosts by a relative integer offset. Group members are mapped to their host once and locked nodes fail the whole command.

commands.name: canvas.create-requirement
commands.description: Create one reusable Requirement node with an optional explicit ordered SOURCE/REFERENCE input set. Creation never executes the Requirement and commits the node and all bindings together.

commands.name: canvas.update-requirement
commands.description: Atomically update a Requirement title, instructions, or complete ordered input binding set. expectedRevision is a required compare-and-set guard. Editing imported Skill instructions preserves the import fingerprint as source identity and marks the Skill locally modified.

commands.name: canvas.execute-requirement
commands.description: Validate and execute one current Requirement or Skill through the same frozen Requirement TaskScope path as the GUI, then wait for the current Agent turn to settle. A repeated unchanged run requires confirmedUnchanged=true; a busy Agent or stale revision fails before dispatch.

commands.name: canvas.fit
commands.description: Fit current results into view.

commands.name: canvas.clear
commands.description: Clear failed results or, with explicit confirmation, the whole canvas.

commands.name: canvas.delete-selected
commands.description: Delete selected nodes after explicit user authorization.

commands.name: canvas.create-container
commands.description: Create an image container; omit role for a normal container.

commands.name: canvas.import
commands.description: Copy local images into the active project and place them on the canvas.

commands.name: canvas.import-skill
commands.args:
{ "markdown": "---
name: product-photo
description: Product photography guidance
---

Follow these instructions...", "sourceName": "SKILL.md", "x": 240, "y": 180 }
commands.description: Import one bounded SKILL.md document as a reusable Skill-backed requirement node. An unchanged exact re-import selects the existing node. If that node's instructions were edited locally, the response returns exact:false and conflict:locally-modified without overwriting local text.

commands.name: canvas.export-image
commands.description: Export one canvas image through the native Save dialog as PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, or TIFF. Conversion is local, does not call an image model, and never overwrites the managed source asset. Recorded remote assets are accepted only through the app's public-HTTP(S), redirect-validated managed asset path.

commands.name: agent.chat
commands.description: Start an idle task and wait for its current Agent turn to settle. While a task is already running, this command performs a text-only steer with the frozen TaskScope kept unchanged and returns after acceptance; sourceNodeIds are then rejected and explicit attachment changes must use agent.steer. Every supplied sourceNodeId must still exist; a mixed valid/stale list fails before any Agent call.

commands.name: agent.goal
commands.description: Preview or execute a Goal across either the exact sourceNodeIds or, when omitted, all eligible SOURCE image containers. operationsPerAsset freezes the number of requested operations for every eligible source asset. Empty, generating, stale, and reference-only containers are rejected or reported as skipped before dispatch. First omit confirmed (or use false) to receive requiresConfirmation, counts, and a one-time snapshot.snapshotHash bound to prompt, sourceNodeIds, operationsPerAsset, TaskScope, and billing. Execute only by repeating those exact values with confirmed=true and expectedSnapshotHash. Changed inputs, stale canvas state, cross-project use, and replay fail with zero dispatch. The command waits for the current Agent turn to settle.

commands.name: commerce.compose-set
commands.description: Compose a deterministic cross-border commerce listing-set prompt and submit it through the same two-stage Goal preview/confirmation gate. sourceNodeIds are exact and atomic. The plan determines operationsPerAsset. Preview returns confirmationArgs containing the original sourceNodeIds and plan, plus composition.normalizedPlan for observation and the compatibility alias composition.plan. Execute only by spreading confirmationArgs unchanged and adding confirmed=true plus the preview snapshot hash; never reconstruct confirmation input from either normalized-plan field. This command never bypasses agent.goal confirmation.

slots.title: Hero image
slots.prompt: Keep the exact product identity and create a clean white-background hero composition.

slots.title: Detail image
slots.prompt: Show the real visible material and construction details without inventing specifications.

plan.title: Localized marketplace listing set

targetLocales.prompt: Use concise US marketplace wording and preserve brand names, model numbers, numbers, and units.
Use natural concise Japanese commerce wording with readable line breaks and hierarchy.

plan.translatePrompt: Translate only text that is visibly present and preserve the product, layout intent, trademarks, and factual claims.

commands.name: agent.steer
commands.description: Change the active task, independently keep, replace, append, or clear SOURCE/REFERENCE attachments, persist a re-hashed TaskScope snapshot, interrupt the current phase, and return only after acceptance. sourceMode/referenceMode override the compatible taskScopeMode shorthand. Every supplied node ID must exist; replace/merge requires a non-empty corresponding ID list and never executes a valid subset of a stale request.

commands.name: agent.pause
commands.description: Pause dispatch at the next runtime boundary; an accepted upstream request may still finish.

commands.name: agent.resume
commands.description: Resume a paused task and fail the command if the runtime does not accept the resume.

commands.name: agent.stop
commands.description: Stop the active task while preserving completed results. Missing active work or a failed backend cancellation is a top-level command failure, never a successful idle response.

commands.name: agent.new-conversation
commands.description: Start a conversation without clearing canvas results.

notes.title: Images and containers
notes.body: For generation, editing, variants, cutout, redraw, and layer work, select the intended sources and use `agent.chat`. The Agent preserves provenance and creates results through the same runtime as the GUI.

notes.title: Responses and errors
notes.body: Successful output is JSON with `ok: true` and `result`. Failures use `ok: false` and `error`. Retry a `rendererReady: false` status briefly. Never expose endpoint authorization data.

notes.title: Renderer lifecycle
notes.body: Every Agent run and pending automation command is owned by the Renderer that dispatched it. If that Renderer closes or crashes, naimage immediately rejects its pending CLI commands, aborts its run, and prevents further dispatch without affecting other Renderer owners. Provider requests already accepted upstream continue draining under Main-process admission and may still complete or incur charges. Application shutdown aborts all runs before transports are dismantled.

notes.title: Goal dispatch safety
notes.body: A Goal preview issues a cryptographically random, ten-minute, one-time confirmation bound to the complete automation request (including prompt, sourceNodeIds, operationsPerAsset, or commerce plan), frozen TaskScope, billing quote, active project, conversation, and issuing surface. Re-previewing revokes that surface's older token. The first execution attempt burns the token before busy, preflight, live-scope, billing, or dispatch checks; changed inputs, stale scopes, changed costs, cross-context use, cancellation, and replay are rejected before dispatch and require a fresh preview. commerce.compose-set composes a structured plan but passes through this same gate. Goal execution uses the app's configured concurrency limit, but first serially probes 1-2 distinct SOURCE images, preferring different containers when available. Renderer windows share one Main-process Goal admission controller: queued probes take priority over new ramp waves, and admitted Goals fairly share the frozen process capacity. The app expands only after request acceptance, asset persistence, and result validation succeed; protected failures open a cross-Goal circuit. A bounded transport retry pauses every new ramp wave until the request settles, and closing a Renderer does not release its reservation until the real provider Promise drains. These safeguards stop only work that has not yet been dispatched. An upstream request already accepted by a provider may still complete and incur charges, so process-wide admission is not a cost guarantee.

notes.title: Commerce plan contract
notes.body: For commerce.compose-set, languageCodes and targetLocales are mutually exclusive and every language code must come from the canonical commerce language registry. Unknown languages or supplying both fields fails before plugin composition, Goal preview, or provider dispatch. Treat composition.normalizedPlan and composition.plan as read-only quote details; preserve and spread the preview's confirmationArgs byte-for-byte when confirming.
